subject: [hw] DONE R2 rev 2: P03/P04/J04 accepted; kernel gate green; IP F15 still the one open HIGH; D01 F22-F25
body:
DONE R2 rev 2. Supersedes rev 1 with the packages that landed after it. Host-only; no phone, no publish, no commit.

Self-check:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/review/r2/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST R2 PASS 27/27

Verdicts on the current tree (all suites re-run by me):
  K01  accept with F9 (no DONE post; NV12 sound, YUYV chroma address medium)
  K02  accept (final a939f107; 588871/588871 x2)
  IK   accept (final relay a2e90ed5; 1479/1479 x2; 0299 e04aa289 embeds the exact files; compile 0 unknown)
  J02  accept with F11-F13 (1483/1483)
  J04  accept with F30/F31 (5296/5296): 11 words [V], 9+4 [I]; hardware decode NOT proven
  P03  accept (rev2, 550/550; F26-F29 fixed)
  P04  accept with F32/F33 (rev1, 5031/5031; -12915 [I], registration hook is IP)
  IP   accept with F15 HIGH open (722/722; F14 fixed)
  D01  accept with F22-F25 (32/32; FACTS 1.10 infracfg offsets, 4-vs-5 count, mixed marks, 4:2:2 stride)
  P04/J04/IJ: no other open finding.

Kernel hand-off: GO (K02 a939 + IK a2e90ed5 + 0299 e04aa289, compile 0 unknown). K01 F9 only affects YUYV.

One HIGH remains before a phone daemon run: IP F15. host/n2vhost.c:59 still weak-defines n2shim_thread (and stdio/android/data) and build_ios.sh still plain-links libn2vhost.a, so the product vcodecd can carry empty thread/stdio tables (opus-ios: 77 unresolved, no M-c). Fix: -Wl,-force_load / --whole-archive, or IV drops the weak definitions; add the "tables thread/stdio non-zero" assertion to t_real. P03 also reports build_ios.sh fails on _pthread_key_create/_pthread_setspecific/_strnlen missing from daemon/sdk_symbols.txt (IP file).

Rule sweep: no binaries/vendor copies in package dirs; only IK/K01 test scripts lack SPDX (line 1 or 2); 0299 current. No new violation.

Files: gpu/hwcodec/review/r2/{FINDINGS.md,STATUS.md,run_tests.sh}. I stay available for review requests and will re-run any package whose owner changes a file.
